description: Defines the NavigationController class for managing tags, views, and navigation state in a web application, including methods for creating, selecting, updating, and removing tags and views, as well as handling context menus and persistence.

classes.name: NavigationController
classes.description: Controller class managing navigation tags, views, and UI state, including creation, selection, editing, and deletion of tags and views, as well as context menu handling and persistence.

classes.name: TagsCountsState
classes.description: Helper class for maintaining and updating counts of notes associated with tags.

methods.name: findAndSetTag
methods.description: Finds a tag or view by UUID and sets it as selected.

methods.name: selectHydratedTagOrDefault
methods.description: Selects a tag based on persisted UUID or defaults to home view.

methods.name: getPersistableValue
methods.description: Returns the current navigation state for persistence.

methods.name: hydrateFromPersistedValue
methods.description: Restores navigation state from persisted data.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up resources and disposers.

methods.name: createSubtagAndAssignParent
methods.description: Creates a new subtag under a parent tag and assigns its parent.

methods.name: isInSmartView
methods.description: Checks if current view is a SmartView.

methods.name: isInHomeView
methods.description: Checks if current view is the home (all notes) view.

methods.name: isInFilesView
methods.description: Checks if current view is the files view.

methods.name: isTagFilesView
methods.description: Checks if a given tag is the files view.

methods.name: tagUsesTableView
methods.description: Determines if a tag uses table view based on preferences.

methods.name: isInAnySystemView
methods.description: Checks if current view is any system view.

methods.name: isInSystemView
methods.description: Checks if current view matches a specific system view ID.

methods.name: selectedAsTag
methods.description: Returns the selected item as a SNTag if applicable.

methods.name: setAddingSubtagTo
methods.description: Sets the subtag being added.

methods.name: setContextMenuOpen
methods.description: Opens or closes the context menu.

methods.name: setContextMenuClickLocation
methods.description: Sets the location where the context menu was triggered.

methods.name: setContextMenuPosition
methods.description: Sets the position of the context menu.

methods.name: setContextMenuMaxHeight
methods.description: Sets the maximum height of the context menu.

methods.name: reloadContextMenuLayout
methods.description: Recalculates and adjusts the context menu layout based on viewport.

methods.name: allLocalRootTags
methods.description: Returns root tags, including the editing template if applicable.

methods.name: getNotesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of notes for a specific tag.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Retrieves child tags of a given tag.

methods.name: isValidTagParent
methods.description: Checks if a parent tag is valid for a given tag.

methods.name: hasParent
methods.description: Checks if a tag has a parent.

methods.name: assignParent
methods.description: Assigns a parent to a tag, updating relationships and syncing.

methods.name: rootTags
methods.description: Returns tags with no parent.

methods.name: tagsCount
methods.description: Returns total number of tags.

methods.name: setAllNotesCount
methods.description: Sets the total notes count.

methods.name: setAllFilesCount
methods.description: Sets the total files count.

methods.name: allFilesCount
methods.description: Gets total files count.

methods.name: allNotesCount
methods.description: Gets total notes count.

methods.name: previouslySelected
methods.description: Returns the previously selected tag/view.

methods.name: selected
methods.description: Returns the currently selected tag/view.

methods.name: setPanelWidthForTag
methods.description: Sets the panel width preference for a tag.

methods.name: setSelectedTag
methods.description: Sets a tag as selected, updating UI and publishing events.

methods.name: selectHomeNavigationView
methods.description: Selects the home (all notes) view.

methods.name: selectFilesView
methods.description: Selects the files view.

methods.name: homeNavigationView
methods.description: Gets the default home view.

methods.name: filesNavigationView
methods.description: Gets the files view.

methods.name: setSelectedTagInstance
methods.description: Updates internal selected tag instance.

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.description: Expands or collapses a tag.

methods.name: setFavorite
methods.description: Marks a tag as favorite or not.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for a tag.

methods.name: editingTag
methods.description: Gets the tag or view currently being edited.

methods.name: setEditingTag
methods.description: Sets a tag or view into editing mode.

methods.name: createNewTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new template tag.

methods.name: undoCreateNewTag
methods.description: Cancels creation of a new tag.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a tag or view, with optional user confirmation.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves changes to a tag or view, with validation.
